name: MA-CHMINACA
summary: AMB-CHMINACA or MMB-CHMINACA (also known as MA-CHMINACA) is an indazole-based synthetic cannabinoid that is a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor and has been sold online as a designer drug.

pharmacology.text: AMB-CHMINACA or MMB-CHMINACA (also known as MA-CHMINACA) is an indazole-based synthetic cannabinoid that is a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor and has been sold online as a designer drug.

uses.text: AMB-CHMINACA or MMB-CHMINACA (also known as MA-CHMINACA) is an indazole-based synthetic cannabinoid that is a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor and has been sold online as a designer drug.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it specifically. Potent synthetic cannabinoids of its kind have caused a racing heart, agitation, vomiting, psychosis, seizures, kidney injury and deaths, and regular use can lead to dependence with withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它本身所知甚少。同類的強效合成大麻素曾造成心跳過快、躁動、嘔吐、精神病、癲癇發作、腎臟損傷甚至死亡，經常使用也可能導致依賴與戒斷。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它本身所知甚少。同类的强效合成大麻素曾造成心跳过快、躁动、呕吐、精神病、癫痫发作、肾脏损伤甚至死亡，经常使用也可能导致依赖与戒断。

fact.en: Like many synthetic cannabinoid names, it is chemical shorthand: CHM stands for its cyclohexylmethyl tail and INACA for its indazole carboxamide core.
fact.zh: 和許多合成大麻素的名稱一樣，它是化學縮寫：「CHM」代表環己基甲基尾端，「INACA」代表吲唑甲醯胺核心。
fact.zhHans: 和许多合成大麻素的名称一样，它是化学缩写：「CHM」代表环己基甲基尾端，「INACA」代表吲唑甲酰胺内核。
